findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bluesky_search, hackernews_search, x_search, reddit_search, tiktok_search, social_search, social_accounts, people_search, tiktok_followers, tiktok_following · Private data: linkedin_profile · Public sink: bluesky_search, bluesky_posts, bluesky_profile, x_search, x_posts, x_profile, reddit_search, reddit_comments, instagram_profile, threads_posts, social_audience, linkedin_company · Destructive: social_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bluesky_search, hackernews_search, x_search, reddit_search, tiktok_search, social_search, social_accounts, people_search, tiktok_followers, tiktok_following · Private data: linkedin_profile · Public sink: bluesky_search, bluesky_posts, bluesky_profile, x_search, x_posts, x_profile, reddit_search, reddit_comments, instagram_profile, threads_posts, social_audience, linkedin_company · Destructive: social_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
